name: Customizable Spring Footings for Replicator 2/2X Build Plate

captions.detailed: A 3D-printable build plate footing designed with a wide, flat circular base and a taller, narrower concentric inner column. The top edge of the column is chamfered to facilitate smooth insertion. A central hole runs completely through the vertical axis of the part, featuring countersunk/beveled entries on both the top and bottom faces to accommodate screw heads.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script for a 3D printer build plate footing. The design must feature a wide circular base of adjustable diameter and height, a narrower inner column, a central mounting screw hole, and chamfers at both the top outer edge of the column and the entry/exit edges of the central hole.
captions.factory: The part is built using a difference() operation. The positive volume is a union() of three cylinders: a flat base cylinder, a main inner column cylinder, and a translated chamfered cylinder at the top of the column. The negative volume subtracted consists of a central through-hole cylinder, a translated top chamfer cylinder with expanding radius, and a bottom chamfer cylinder with a decreasing radius to create clean countersunk entries.
